d: A youthful, adolescent figure with a slender build, featuring vibrant magenta hair styled in twin pigtails with long, sweeping bangs and colorful iridescent streaks of yellow, teal, and purple. The large, shimmering magenta eyes have star-shaped pupils and a bright, cheerful expression. The outfit consists of a neon lime-green hooded jacket worn open over a hot pink cropped top with a cyan criss-cross lattice pattern, paired with matching hot pink leggings and a utility belt holding various colorful canisters. Signature details include two rounded, glowing yellow and teal antennae-like protrusions emerging from the top of the head and a black choker around the neck.
